content:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api us-west-2 queue growth detected. GPU pool `hosted-usw2-gpu` at 98% alloc, pending queue length +420 in last 5m, p95 token latency 3.9s -> 9.8s, p99 9.6s -> 21.4s. Autoscaler reported repeated CreateInstance failed: QuotaExceeded (x-ref: provisioner/err/1749998881). Paging on-call.

sre_jess: paging @eng_oncall_mike — can you pick this up? Seeing 500+ queued requests for the hosted text-gen route. Customers reporting 504s. :rotating_light:

eng_oncall_mike: on it. grabbing graphs now. any known deploys? @platform_ana any rollout recently to hosted pools?

platform_ana: no planned deploys in us-west-2. I see a spike at 10:06 UTC that correlates with traffic from partner A (high throughput). Autoscaler logs show repeated failures to provision G5 instances with error QuotaExceeded from cloud provider.

prod_ops_tariq: customer-impact: multiple enterprise customers on hosted tier reported increased 5xx and slow responses over last 8m. Support queue has ~12 tickets. tagging @support_lara

support_lara: informed affected accounts and flagged S3 logs + request IDs. customers want ETA for mitigation.

eng_oncall_mike: digging into autoscaler. recent change to autoscaler max_nodes cap set to 70 in config, but cloud quota for GPU-core region limit is 48 — looks like mismatch. autoscaler retried create and hit provider quota 48/48.

obs_bot: metric snapshot: queue_length = 432, running_GPU_workers = 46, pending_provision = 18, create_instance_failures = 18 (QuotaExceeded), request_504s = 94 in 10m, median_request_tokens = 1200.

sre_jess: immediate mitigations: 1) enable degraded routing to quantized-small model (q4f32) for non-enterprise customers 2) enable request prioritization for enterprise tokens 3) throttle anonymous/free tier at 2 rps/user. Anyone can flip these? @infra_neil can you assist with routing toggles?

infra_neil: applying routing policy now — switching non-enterprise route -> q4f32 model variant. Command run:
```
infractl route update hosted-usw2 --route "text.gen" --policy "degrade_non_enterprise:q4f32"
```
response: OK queued. will take ~30s to propagate.

eng_oncall_mike: also bumping client-timeout to 30s at the edge for hosted-api to avoid long-running token drain. This will return 429 earlier for backlog-heavy requests. Patching edge config:
```
edgectl set-timeout --env hosted --region usw2 --timeout 30s
```

incident-bot: NOTE: routing change applied (propagation id 98321). Edge timeout patch in progress.

platform_ana: provisioning workaround: we have a private Dedicated pool with spare capacity in eu-west-1. Can we route a subset of requests (high-cost customers) to Dedicated via geo-failover until quota request completes? That will need a quick canary and token mapping.

sre_jess: yes — prioritize enterprise by token: map enterprise tokens to dedicated cluster. @infra_neil / @prod_ops_tariq coordinate.

prod_ops_tariq: mapping started. sample mapping command:
```
opsctl map-tokens --src hosted-usw2 --dst dedicated-euw1 --tokens-file enterprise-tokens-urgent.csv --dry-run=false
```

infra_neil: mapping pushed. routing logs show enterprise traffic outbound to dedicated-euw1. latency will be higher (cross-region) but keeps requests alive. :white_check_mark:

eng_oncall_mike: autoscaler leader log shows scale-loop kept trying to create new nodes but provider returned QuotaExceeded. Also seeing that the cluster-level max_nodes config actually read 50 (old value) while infra config said 70. We need to sync config stores. @platform_ana can you reconcile stores?

platform_ana: found stale config in Consul (max_nodes: 50) vs gitops (70). rolling back gitops to 50 to stop thrash and open a quota request with cloud. Applying immediate fix to stop further create retries.

obs_bot: after routing and throttles: queue_length down to 180 within 4m, p95 6.1s, p99 12.3s. 504s decreased to 28 in last 5m.

sre_jess: good. next: 1) open cloud support ticket requesting quota increase to 80 GPUs in us-west-2 2) update autoscaler to respect provider quota and backoff on QuotaExceeded 3) postmortem to track config drift.

eng_oncall_mike: opened cloud ticket #CS-99282 requesting emergency quota bump — ETA 2h (we asked for expedited). also patched autoscaler backoff: create backoff window increased to 5m on quota failures.

support_lara: sent proactive note to affected enterprise customers: "Routing to alternate pool in progress; you may see higher latency temporarily. We're working to restore local capacity. Will update within 60m." Customers acknowledged. @sales_carla notified for account impact.

sales_carla: noted — will escalate for top-3 accounts if we get further degradation.

infra_neil: small housekeeping: scaled down low-priority non-enterprise pools to free up worker slots (manual eviction of idle) — ran
```
infractl pool scale hosted-usw2-nonprod --replicas 12
```
freed ~8 GPUs for prioritized requests.

obs_bot: after frees and mapping: running_GPU_workers = 54 (including dedicated mapping), queue_length = 96, p95 = 3.8s, p99 = 8.1s, 504s = 7 last 5m.

sre_jess: looks like stabilizing. keeping on-call loop open until quota ticket resolves or we confirm autoscaler backoff is healthy. @eng_oncall_mike — please lead handoff when you leave.

eng_oncall_mike: will stay on for another 45m. leaving notes: - cause: config drift + provider quota hole amplified by request surge - immediate mitigations: degraded routing, token mapping to dedicated, throttle anonymous, free up non-prod GPUs - next steps: harden autoscaler backoff, add quota-aware preflight check, enforce single source-of-truth for max_nodes.

prod_ops_tariq: customer-impact tally: 14 enterprise customers saw transient errors, support opened 14 tickets, 3 escalations; CS lead assigned follow-ups.

incident-bot: REMINDER: Add incident tag `capacity/quota-usw2` and set severity S2. Create incident channel if PM wants a broader comms thread.

sre_jess: creating incident doc. linking ops runbook and will assign PM and infra owners in doc. Also schedule postmortem with platform_ana + infra_neil + eng_oncall_mike + prod_ops_tariq.

eng_oncall_mike: final note before handoff: if we see queue grow >200 again, set autoscaler to manual scale up to 60 workers (manual override) and trigger full account prioritization. I'll handoff to @sre_jess after the 45m watch.

support_lara: will follow up with customers once we have definitive ETA from cloud.

sre_jess: thanks all. handing to morning shift oncall @infra_neil for follow-on. I'll keep the incident doc updated. :coffee:

infra_neil: ack. I've left runbook pointers and the quick commands used in #runbooks for fast reuse.

eng_oncall_mike: (last) leaving logs and timeline in incident doc. Please escalate if any regression. over and out.

incident-bot: AUTOMATION: incident channel created #incident-1749998881-capacity-quota-usw2. Tagging owners: sre_jess, eng_oncall_mike, platform_ana, infra_neil.

sre_jess: post-incident action items (short): [1] Enforce gitops -> consul reconciliation job, [2] Autoscaler: respect quota + exponential backoff for QuotaExceeded, [3] Add preflight quota check step before autoscaler spikes, [4] Update runbook to include dedicated fallback mapping steps. Longer-term: telemetry to detect config drift, and one-click customer communication template.
